---
title: "Predictive Modeling with Pipelines in tidymodels and scikit-learn"
---

::: columns
::: {.column width="48%"}
In this workshop, we will use **predictive modeling** to analyze data about NHL
hockey players between 2006 and 2018.  The goal is to learn and practice the
standard workflow used for machine learning analysis:

1. Cleaning the data
2. Visualizing relationships
3. Choosing predictor (input) variables
4. Choosing between competing models
5. Interpreting model conclusions
6. Ethics considerations

:::

## Accessing Workshop Materials

You can either work **locally** with the workshop materials (on your own laptop)
or **remotely** (online). To work locally, you will need to have either R or 
Python installed on your computer, and a variety of packages. If you do not 
have either of these installed, you can still work online!
